title: Hyperbolic Time Series Forecasting with Learnable Decomposition and Manifold Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.15760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multiscale structure is central to time series forecasting: temporal signals contain slowly varying trends, intermediate seasonal patterns, and high-frequency residuals. Traditional forecasters model this multiscale structure in Euclidean space, without representing the ordering it induces among components. We identify that cascaded decomposition orders components by their characteristic frequencies, forming a natural frequency hierarchy. This hierarchy aligns with the exponential volume growth of hyperbolic space, which provides increasing representational capacity with radius and naturally accommodates nested hierarchies. We propose HyperForecast, the first long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) framework operating in hyperbolic space. translated_title: 基于可学习分解与流形动力学的双曲时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 多尺度结构是时间序列预测的核心：时间信号包含缓慢变化的趋势、中间尺度的季节性模式以及高频残差。传统预测模型在欧几里得空间中对这种多尺度结构进行建模，却未能表征其在各分量之间诱导出的排序关系。我们发现级联分解会按特征频率对分量进行排序，从而形成一种天然的频率层级结构。该层级结构与双曲空间的指数体积增长特性相契合——双曲空间随着半径增大提供越来越大的表示容量，并能自然地容纳嵌套层级。我们提出HyperForecast，这是首个在双曲空间中运行的长期时间序列预测（LTSF）框架。HyperForecast将分解后的时间片段嵌入到庞加莱球上，其中径向距离刻画了这种嵌套结构，即从靠近原点的低频分量到外围的高频分量。
tldr: 该论文提出首个在双曲空间中运行的长期时间序列预测框架HyperForecast，通过可学习分解将时间信号按频率层级嵌入庞加莱球，利用双曲空间的指数容量自然表征频率嵌套结构以提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes HyperForecast, the first long-term time series forecasting framework operating in hyperbolic space, which embeds decomposed temporal components in a frequency hierarchy on the Poincaré ball, leveraging hyperbolic geometry's exponential capacity to naturally represent nested frequency structures.
